scope: Publish original exact d24 runtime evidence into append-only Git files for independent acceptance review. Do not change the tested runtime, rerun tests to chase PASS, or make independent/canonical decisions. This is the same parent P7 mission and sole Implementer.

design_brief.problem_statement: Generation-81 independent PASS records require committed immutable machine evidence; external Actions URLs and Implementer summaries alone are insufficient.
design_brief.current_behavior: P7 and PC0 artifacts are downloaded and digest-checked, full world job 101741388863 is still running, and the separate Verifier dispatch was explicitly rejected for missing Codex environment.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Preserve exact original evidence and command/HEAD/TREE/runner/run/artifact bindings in Git without implying that a mechanical publisher is an independent Verifier.
alternatives_considered: Treat external links as canonical machine evidence
Publish complete reused original logs and summaries under a fixed evidence path
design_brief.selected_design: A narrowly guarded evidence-only job may read the fixed run artifacts, verify digest and exact clean subject, then append original UTF-8 log/JSON bytes, failure observations, and machine manifests only under docs/control/p7-eg1-world-core-repair-r1/evidence/d24-r1/. It must not execute downloaded content. A complete PASS runtime packet may be emitted only after all world and P7 predicates pass; control failures and rejected dispatch remain separate failures.
design_brief.why_selected: Makes existing trustworthy CI evidence durable and inspectable while preserving role independence, runtime freeze, and historical authority.
dependencies: Completed exact run 34121804645 world and P7 artifacts
Actual fresh independent role reports before canonical proposal
expected_risks: World job may expose another failure
validation_plan: Unit-test unsafe paths, duplicate JSON, subject drift, failed/incomplete coverage and digest failures
Require original 325 scripts and 328 world stages
Require original 29 P7 leaves and 2032 assertions
Require expected negative and positive ENet/EG4 controls plus fixed process campaigns
Verify only evidence-carrier changes relative to d24
Commit through normal fast-forward only; refuse concurrent ref movement or an existing output path
Verify committed artifacts and manifests using the current generation-81 provenance validator where applicable
Keep every missing independent/human predicate explicitly open

publisher_authority.event: owner push with explicit [p7-archive-d24] marker on the fixed repair branch
publisher_authority.contents_write_scope: Evidence-only job token; generated commit restricted to the fixed append-only evidence directory on the repair branch

notes: This Work Order authorizes bounded evidence publication only. It is neither a machine-registered execution nor an acceptance record. Never convert the recorded CloseRole exit3 to PASS or claim that an unstarted Verifier executed.
